name: lumen-a11y
description: Lumen — on-device accessibility copilot (Chrome extension) using Firebase AI Logic hybrid inference.

scripts.build: vite build && vite build --config vite.content.config.ts && node scripts/copy-axe.mjs
scripts.build:demo: npm run build && vite build --config vite.demo.config.ts && node scripts/finish-demo.mjs
scripts.build:keyless: vite build --mode keyless && vite build --config vite.content.config.ts && node scripts/copy-axe.mjs
